title: Hruday node and sign certificates for the limit of the named constructions
accepted: In the AM2/AQ1 zero-selected patterned family (model AQ_patterned_zero_selected: SU(2) Kogut-Susskind form on Z^3 at fixed spacing, coarse 24-link factors, selected triple exactly (0,0,0) with Haar product reference, whole stars phi_b=-(tau/3) sum W_f in normalized units delta=alpha/8; tau=+10^-8, with tau=-10^-8 a replay of the same |tau| formula at the mirrored coupling; original xz Wilson loop W with complete cover R={0,e_z} and ||W|| at most 1; trace norm on B(H_R); Euclidean clock s=alpha t_E/hbar with G=H/alpha at the single preregistered node s=1; real-time clock theta=alpha t/hbar), with omega_inf the limit of the named constructions admitted in BB2 (gate sha256 ad3fdb4bee935b594c992f6d4246b52aa83b9c0d0d03eb5186bff47b45bb0cca, accepted_within_scope: the reduced densities of F1 = AQ1 centered whole-star boxes Lambda_N=[-N,N]^3 and F2 = I1 section 6 all-contained-face boxes with padding on the same Lambda_N, N at least 2, converge as whole sequences on every finite region to one common limit, which equals every AQ1 subsequential limit and every F2 subsequential limit, items 1-3), this identification being used before any certificate is inherited: For the zero-selected patterned family at tau=10^-8, the limit of the named construction families F1 and F2 admitted in BB2 satisfies the Round32 node certificate at s=1 with the unchanged datum and radius and the Round32 enclosure of the static Wilson mean with the unchanged endpoints, and every padded box Lambda_N with N at least the exactly computed N_sign has a static Wilson mean of certified sign; these are restatements of admitted certificates for one limit of the named constructions and a finite-box corollary, not uniqueness of any ground state, not an interaction shift of the Euclidean correlation, and not a statement uniform in the lattice spacing a. Values (exact; read from the hash-verified gates and restated unchanged). Finite-box corollary (the one new constant family, tier exact_first_order; inputs in place of a route: the AW2 gate endpoints and C' of the BB2 gate decision, assembly nested_telescoping, BB1 route polymer_kp, hypothesis source bb1_frozen_targets): for every N at least 2 the untruncated F2 finite-box ground state at fixed N satisfies |omega^{F2,N}(W)-omega_inf(W)| <= ||W|| ||rho^{F2,N}_R-rho^inf_R||_1 <= C' q^(N-1) with C'=4/984375 and q=1/64 (the BB2 item-1 whole-sequence bound with M tending to infinity through the closed trace-norm ball), so omega^{F2,N}(W) lies in [L-C' q^(N-1), U+C' q^(N-1)], and at tau=-10^-8 in [-U-C' q^(N-1), -L+C' q^(N-1)]. N_sign, the least N at least 2 with C' q^(N-1) strictly below L=tau/144-K_2^+ tau^2, is exactly 4: the widening is 1/15750000 at N=2, 1/1008000000 at N=3 and 1/64512000000 at N=4. At N=4 the widened enclosure is [232256915653307984268043972456662444208313/E, 369480171452763518908899363269803522461511/E] with E=4332507027163714822873992017230554960022732800000000 (about 5.36079720580e-11 to 8.52809168309e-11), with its mirror at tau=-10^-8, and the sign of omega^{F2,N}(W) equals the sign of tau for every N at least 4 at both signs. Nothing is claimed for N=2 and N=3 (open row N4), for cutoff-L F2 states or for a finite-box node (open rows N2 and N3); the F1 boxes are as certified by AW2 at every N at least 2 (recorded as agreement). The density rate in N is q^(N-1) for every N at least 2, per coarse step at fixed spacing. Common GNS item: the F1 and F2 limits are one state (BB2 items 2-3) with one GNS triple, whose dynamics is the AQ1 limit dynamics T_theta implemented in that representation (AQ1 for F1, BA2 item 4 for F2); its correlation functions on |theta| at most 8 are the limits of the finite-box correlation functions of either family (BB2 item 5), with a rate in N (K5/N) only on 5<=N<=14000 and convergence without a rate beyond; this concerns one state and is not equality of GNS dynamics of different states. Obligations (the reviewed table of 21 rows): AY2 row O1 is closed only in the narrow form that all subsequential limits of F1 and F2 coincide on every finite region (one limit of the named constructions, BB2 items 2-3, row O1a); uniqueness of any ground state, states outside the named constructions and other boundary conditions are not proved and remain open (rows O1b and N1); rows O2-O6 are closed within the scopes of the BB2 and BA2 gates; rows N1-N14 are open. Labelled information, not claimed: L/(C' q^3) is about 4.4584 and the widened exclusion margin at N=4, (L-C' q^3)/(K_2^+ tau^2+C' q^3), is about 3.3851.
limitations: Scope: only the zero-selected patterned family (selected triple (0,0,0), Haar reference), fixed spacing, tau=10^-8 with tau=-10^-8 a mirror replay of the same |tau| formula (never a second confirmation), the cover R={0,e_z} and the original xz Wilson loop W, the single node s=1, the limit of the named constructions omega_inf and the untruncated F2 finite-box ground states at fixed N; nothing transfers to other selected triples, the route-B uniform model (BC2), other boundary conditions, states outside the named constructions, literal vertex boxes, weak coupling or the continuum, and no estimate is uniform in the lattice spacing a.

Restatement only: the node certificate is the AV2 certificate with d, R and the interval unchanged and the free reference e^{-3}/4 inside the interval (reference_unresolved), so no interaction shift, sign or coefficient of C(s) is claimed; the static Wilson mean is the AW2 enclosure with its endpoints and the full second-order remainder K_2^+ tau^2 unchanged (static_not_dynamic); no constant of either certificate is re-derived or retuned, and no Round32 gate, report or snapshot is edited.

Identification: the AV2 and AW2 certificates are stated for every state in the whole set of AQ1 subsequential limits (AW2 also in every centered whole-star box at every on-site cutoff); they pass to omega_inf only because BB2 items 2-3 admit that this set is the one limit of the named constructions. BB2 carries its own limitations: the BB1 discharge at the frozen targets, the Kotecky-Preiss citation checked post hoc against the committed excerpt, and the AY1 itemization as a reviewed local reading for non-centred F2 volumes in the fifth BB1 comparison.

Finite-box sign: certified only for the untruncated F2 finite-box ground states at fixed N with N at least N_sign=4, at both signs, through the BB2 whole-sequence bound at the BB2 gate bound value C'=4/984375 with q=1/64 and ||W|| at most 1 (the labelled union_comparison value and the labelled re-evaluated values are not used); N=2 and N=3 are open (row N4) because the widened interval contains 0 there; cutoff-L F2 states are not claimed; the F1 boxes are as certified by AW2, recorded as agreement and not re-derived. C' at the hypothesis values does not depend on tau and AW2 admits the enclosure at the cap only, so nothing below the cap is claimed.

No finite-box node: the admitted AV2 record states the window lemma and the comparison only for the GNS vector of an AQ1 subsequential state, so no node certificate for F1 or F2 boxes is restated (rows N2 and N3, open).

O1 in the narrow form only: AY2 row O1 is closed only as the statement that all subsequential limits of F1 and F2 coincide on every finite region (one limit of the named constructions, row O1a); uniqueness of any ground state, states outside the named constructions and other boundary conditions are not proved and stay open (rows O1b and N1). The producer status closed_within_scope for the whole AY2 row O1 and its summary sentence that AY2 rows O1-O6 are closed within named scopes are not adopted for the gate text; the frozen producer files are retained as evidence.

Common GNS item and rates: one state with one GNS triple and the AQ1 limit dynamics T_theta; correlation functions only on |theta| at most 8, with a rate in N only on 5<=N<=14000 (BB2 item 5; the bound is vacuous from N=14419 with the frozen r_N) and convergence without a rate beyond; no equality of GNS dynamics of different states and no uniform-in-time statement. The density rate q^(N-1) holds for every N at least 2, per coarse step at fixed spacing.

Labelled only, not claimed: the ratio L/(C' q^3) about 4.4584, the widened exclusion margin about 3.3851, the half-width K_2^+ (tau/100)^2+C' q^3 about 1.5501e-11 against the first-order value about 6.944e-13 at tau/100, and the row-N4 preview sign margin 1/(144 K_2' tau) about 51.76, which rests on an ungated box-level reading of AY1 F13-F14 and on the untruncated F2 passage and is not admitted.

Contract wording read as follows (non-blocking): W1 the selection reason omits that AW2 was also stated in every centered whole-star box; W2 the two claim-exclusion lists differ in one entry (the wider contract entry applied); W3 (equal to skeptic D2) the inherited parameter control asks for d_X, N_0 and weights, and BC1 derives no decay estimate (N_min plays the role of N_0); W4 item 4 needs two open rows where the parameter list has one entry; W5 (equal to skeptic R3) the template leaves the finite-box state implicit (the untruncated F2 ground vector at fixed N); D1 no frame for limited outcomes (moot at this verdict); D3 the inherited clock control is loosely fitted to a statement loop (executed in full).

Phrase-list gap: neither the round list nor this contract's forbidden phrasings contain the AY2 row name or the every-ground-state wording of the claim exclusions, so the negation-aware scanner does not guard the O1 row; the reviewed wording does.

Independence: one forward producer plus the skeptic's pre-comparison replay, all correlated model agents; the forward commit 5816e0b came first and the skeptic pre-comparison package 5ec599f followed 3 min 32 s later, with the skeptic values final before the forward check.py was last written; isolation rests on disclosure and content, including a disclosed name-only exposure of the skeptic to the forward commit subject; the forward report was written by a shell heredoc and is bound by its freeze record.
model: Zero-selected patterned family (AQ_patterned_zero_selected) at tau=+10^-8, with tau=-10^-8 a replay of the same |tau| formula at the mirrored coupling; the limit of the named constructions omega_inf (BB2: the common whole-sequence limit of F1 = AQ1 centered whole-star boxes and F2 = I1 section 6 all-contained-face boxes with padding on Lambda_N, equal to every AQ1 and F2 subsequential limit) and the untruncated finite-box ground states of F2 at fixed N; the original xz Wilson loop W with cover R={0,e_z}; Euclidean clock s=alpha t_E/hbar with G=H/alpha at the single node s=1; static equal-time Wilson mean
decision: Admit the restatement of the Round32 certificates for the limit of the named constructions, a finite-box sign corollary for the padded family, the common GNS item and the updated obligations table. With BB2 items 2-3 as admitted (the F1 and F2 limits coincide on every finite region and equal every AQ1 and every F2 subsequential limit), the AV2 node certificate holds for omega_inf at s=1 with the datum d=497870683678639429793424156500617766317/(4*10^40) and the radius bound R=1831967503411879425147166810021607/10^40 (about 1.83197e-7) unchanged, the free reference e^{-3}/4 inside the interval (reference_unresolved; correlation_shift_resolved false); the AW2 enclosure of omega_inf(W) holds with the endpoints tau/144 minus and plus K_2^+ tau^2 unchanged (about [6.91090e-11, 6.97799e-11] at tau=+10^-8, the mirror at -10^-8). For the padded boxes, |omega^{F2,N}(W)-omega_inf(W)| <= C' q^(N-1) with the BB2 gate bound value C'=4/984375 and q=1/64, for every N at least 2; the sign of omega^{F2,N}(W) is certified for every N at least N_sign=4 at both signs (widened enclosure about [5.36080e-11, 8.52809e-11] at N=4, tau=+10^-8; the widening at N=3 is about 9.92e-10, so N=2,3 stay open); F1 boxes were already certified by AW2 at every N at least 2. No finite-box node is restated (the AV2 record states the node only for the limits); two open rows record it for finite F1 and F2 boxes. The F1 and F2 limits are one state with one GNS triple up to unitary equivalence and one GNS dynamics, the AQ1 limit dynamics T_theta (not equality of GNS dynamics of different states); correlation functions on |theta| at most 8 converge for either family, the rate in N K5/N only on 5<=N<=14000. Obligations: AY2 row O1 is split: O1a, all subsequential limits of F1 and F2 coincide on every finite region (one limit of the named constructions), closed within scope by BB2; O1b, uniqueness of any ground state, states outside the named constructions and other boundary conditions, open; O2-O6 closed within their named scopes (BB2, BA2); 14 further open rows (finite-box nodes, the F2 sign for N=2,3 with a labelled candidate route, the correlation rate beyond N=14000, GNS dynamics of different states, uniform in time, non-centred F2 volumes, the route-B model pending BC2, anything uniform in the lattice spacing a, the continuum problem, the interaction shift of C(s), analyticity of the reduced density, untruncated creation coefficients). Recorded non-blocking: the producer's wording that marked O1 closed as a whole is rejected and replaced by the O1a/O1b split (the phrase scanner's vocabulary does not contain the phrase at issue, so the reviewed wording is the guard); the producer's first report check let two damaging edits through before it was fixed and disclosed; the report was written through a shell heredoc after a tool refusal; the BB2 forward harmonic-fixture sentence names N=119 where the first exceedance is N=83 (no BB2 value depends on it); commit order forward 5816e0b before the skeptic package 5ec599f, with the skeptic's values final before the forward checker was last written and exposure by name only. These are restatements of admitted certificates for one limit of the named constructions and a finite-box corollary; they are not uniqueness of any ground state, not an interaction shift of the Euclidean correlation, not a finite-box node and not uniform in the lattice spacing a.
